name: take_screenshots
title: Take screenshots
description: Take screenshots with the repository's screenshot command: the server runs a scenario in its own sandbox, where the browser starts; images go to 'shots' in your session folder. Waits up to 40 seconds, then may answer `running`: follow it with get_screenshot_run. One run at a time per session.

scenario.description: The scenario module (an ES module, e.g. 'shots/checkout-mobile.mjs'): relative to your working directory, or an absolute path inside it or inside your session folder.

widths.description: Widths of the images in pixels (default 1512, 800, 390, 375).

full_page.description: Capture the whole page by default.

timeout_seconds.description: The scenario's own time limit in seconds, instance start included (default 240).

seed.description: The data the scenario starts from: demo (the default) or none (empty).
